name: Professor Hojo
oracle_text:
The first activated ability you activate during your turn that targets a creature you control costs {2} less to activate.
Whenever one or more creatures you control become the target of an activated ability, draw a card. This ability triggers only once each turn.
blocked_sentences: The first activated ability you activate during your turn that targets a creature you control costs {2} less to activate.

needs.what: an ability_cost_reduction static that reaches ANY activated ability (an 'affects_abilities' class meaning every non-mana activated ability), limited to the first such activation by you each turn during your turn (a per-turn use counter, consumed when a matching activation is paid), combined with the existing 'targeting' clause {controller: you, types: [Creature]}
needs.why_existing_wont_do: ability_cost_reduction requires 'affects_abilities' and ABILITY_CLASS_KEYS holds only 'equip', so it cannot name every activated ability; player_statics.ability_cost_reduction never reads a max_per_turn, and static_max_per_turn is accepted only on graveyard-cast/flashback-style statics, so 'the first ... during your turn' cannot be counted (an is_your_turn condition alone would discount every activation, not the first)
